preconditions.description: k is an integer within the range [2, 12]
The array a_1, a_2, ..., a_{2^k} contains 2^k integers each in the range [0, 2^k)

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Fou' if no such permutations exist, or 'Shi' followed by two lines of 2^k space-separated distinct integers each representing a permutation p and q respectively, such that a_i = p_i ⊕ q_i for all i.
